findings:
🟠 [acceptance-oracle-modified] MUST-FIX The depth-0-owned packages/relay/tests/adversarial/groups.test.ts was modified, and the pre-existing fanout.test.ts was also changed despite the specification allowing changes only to serve.reload.test.ts and claims.test.ts; this invalidates the claimed acceptance evidence. 🟠 [strict-dispatch-address-bypass] MUST-FIX The added `!strictGroups` guard disables the existing `dispatch_needs_instance` address refusal for every strict-mode task_dispatch without `to_filter`, allowing unintended multi-session dispatch and violating the required address-rules-before-ACL ordering. Enforce this refusal in both modes and route strict refusals through the group-aware audit helper.
🟠 [legacy-behavior-regressions] MUST-FIX Legacy mode is no longer byte-identical: `/v1/inbox` exposes the newly added envelope `group`, stream backlog self-exclusion no longer applies to legacy `@team` broadcasts, and presence now accepts a missing summary via `.default('')` instead of returning the prior validation error. Strip internal group data from legacy inbox/SSE output, preserve legacy broadcast self-exclusion, and retain the original presence validation in legacy mode.
